doc: Every place the mod hooks into Minecraft (1.21.1, Fabric API 0.116.17, Mojang names).

event.doc: Fabric API event, mixin target or vanilla override (Mojang names, MC 1.21.1)

rows.event: AttackEntityCallback.EVENT (melee) + Halo weapon hits (WeaponSystem hitscan, HaloProjectile.onHitEntity, Explosions.blast)
rows.purpose: villager/golem/police assault -> wanted stars (melee and ranged)
killing a villager -> wanted stars
reset Halo shield recharge delay, depleted sound
driving off in a car you don't own -> stealing
damaging a police car -> wanted stars
server-side firing; gunfire near villagers is a crime
wanted/police, shield recharge, bus route, skydive, heals in progress
plan loot chests + parked cars once per world (SavedData); each is placed when its chunk loads (no forced generation at world start); reload weapon/shield stats
board the Battle Bus on a player's first join in a world
park cars on village streets
wanted stars, Halo shield bar, ammo counter, heal progress, bus 'press jump' prompt
send trigger state, reload key, zoom, jump-to-drop
holding a gun: left click fires instead of punching
register cache/packs/<game> as required top-priority resource packs
load .cthm meshes from the resource packs
draw Halo weapon meshes in hand
draw GTA cars, the Battle Bus, Halo projectiles
draw the Fortnite chest mesh
pull the camera back while riding the bus / skydiving / driving
sniper/battle rifle scope zoom

rows.handler: CacheGuard.onClientStarted (+ ScreenEvents.AFTER_INIT on TitleScreen: progress screen while blocking, cache-ready check)
rows.purpose: run/refresh the extractor if the cache is missing or failed; reload resources
skip the accessibility onboarding screen on first start

rows.event: Melty test file %LOCALAPPDATA%/Melty/test/craft-theft-halo.json (read once in ModInitializer)
rows.purpose: Melty test runs: report each check (docs/requests/mod.md) once, when it happens in normal play
shield back to systems.shield.start, wanted level cleared after death

rows.event: C2S payload crafttheft:bus_jump (ServerPlayNetworking) + mixin accessor LivingEntity#jumping (LivingEntityAccessor)
rows.purpose: the jump key of a bus rider drops them, also while the server is busy (the vanilla input packet's jumping flag alone can be overwritten before the bus ticks)
draw the Fortnite glider mesh on gliding players
the Halo shield is vanilla absorption shown as the shield bar; hide the golden hearts
drop per-world state kept in statics so the next world in the same game session starts clean
